settings.name: Meera Shah
settings.label: Kora Silk Sari
settings.quote: What stood out most was the attention to detail: the fall, the finish, the way the border sits. Five years on it has not lost a single stitch.

settings.name: Ananya Iyer
settings.label: Chikankari Set
settings.quote: I wore mine to my sister’s mehendi and three people asked where it was from before dinner. It photographs even better than it looks.

settings.name: Radhika Menon
settings.label: Zardozi Lehenga
settings.quote: Knowing the name of the woman who embroidered it changes how you wear it. You carry it with respect, not just with pride.

settings.name: Sana Qureshi
settings.label: Phulkari Kurta
settings.quote: It arrived wrapped in mulmul with a handwritten note about the artisan. It felt like receiving heritage, not a parcel.

settings.name: Kavya Nair
settings.label: Indigo Mulmul Sari
settings.quote: The indigo has softened beautifully with every wash instead of fading. It drapes better in year three than it did on day one.

settings.name: Nisha Bhatia
settings.label: Zari Jacket Set
settings.quote: I ordered for my engagement with three weeks to spare. It came early, altered exactly to measure, and fit like it was drafted on me.

settings.name: Divya Reddy
settings.label: Organza Dupatta
settings.quote: Weightless, but the embroidery still has body. I have worn it over three different outfits and it lifts every one of them.

settings.name: Farah Sheikh
settings.label: Bridal Trousseau
settings.quote: Two years in the making and worth every month. My mother cried when she saw the mirror work on the dupatta.

settings.name: Tara Deshpande
settings.label: Banarasi Silk Sari
settings.quote: I have bought silk at four times this price that did not come close. The zari is real and it shows in the light.

settings.name: Ishita Ghosh
settings.label: Kantha Stole
settings.quote: Every running stitch is slightly different, which is exactly the point. Nothing about it looks machine-made.

settings.name: Aditi Rao
settings.label: Suf Embroidered Kurta
settings.quote: The customer care team sent me photographs from the workshop while it was being stitched. That is not something you forget.

settings.name: Rhea Kapoor
settings.label: Ajrakh Kurta Set
settings.quote: It has become my default for every festive lunch. Comfortable enough to sit through a long meal, sharp enough for photographs.
